entities.name: uS11 ribosomal protein
observations: The 130-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q3Z955, annotated as small ribosomal subunit protein uS11 from Dehalococcoides mccartyi.
uS11 is located on the 30S ribosomal subunit platform, bridges 16S rRNA helices, and contributes to the Shine-Dalgarno cleft in the 70S ribosome.
Annotations include rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and participation in translation; cellular component is ribosome.

entities.name: Translation
observations: The exact-match reference annotates uS11 in GO biological process translation (GO:0006412).

entities.name: Ribosome
observations: The exact-match reference annotates uS11 as a component of the ribosome (GO:0005840), specifically the 30S small subunit.
